title: Draft: Move AFNUM_ values and value_string to packet-bgp.c
description: Just picked a dissector to associate with the data because it's not a public API belonging in \epan, it's just a shared list of values and value_string between multiple dissectors

notes.body:
This direction you are taking seems totally misguided to me. It is the opposite of what is needed.

This is a public API indeed. These address family values are relevant whether you build Wireshark with support for BGP dissection or not. There are many scenarios where they would be useful, from multiple protocols that do not necessarily depend on BGP. If the goal is to be able to customize which dissectors are included, how does this help? You are introducing a hard dependency on BGP or forcing other code to duplicate this value string.

Epan is the right place for them.  The fact that you had to pick a location randomly should clue you in to that.

I'm trying to make epan a "dissection engine" that is protocol agnostic, so I would like "very protocol specific" things out of there.  I don't see epan as the only place for the "public dissection API". So I guess you would say we have a different category of functionality that has historically been in epan, but I would like removed (especially with the addition of Stratoshark). That category is "shared (public) constants and value_strings that belong to a group of dissectors, but there isn't a clear 'parent/owner protocol' where the constants and value_strings should live".
And I don't think this should be packet-afn.[c|h], but maybe that's the way to go.

That explanation doesn't help without addressing the valid concern I already raised. I understood what you are trying to do. I do not have a strong opinion on that. What I do have a strong opinion on is that you shouldn't do it in an ad-hoc fashion and make 10 or so other things worse in the process.

Also just how far does that extend? Are you also going to rename `header_field_info` to something else because it is "packet specific"?

The fact that this value string doesn't have WS_DLL_PUBLC is just an omission. Someone will want to use this in a plugin and either copy paste it or submit a patch to add it.

Public code shouldn't be in epan/dissectors. This isn't always followed perfectly for various reasons but I strongly object to unfixes, FWIW.

> I'm trying to make epan a "dissection engine" that is protocol agnostic, so I would like "very protocol specific" things out of there.

Address space numbers aren't very protocol specific. They could be considered specific to the Internet protocol *suite*, but that's a *lot* of protocols - and third-party developers might have protocols that use them.

> I don't see epan as the only place for the "public dissection API".

So perhaps we need multiple places...

> So I guess you would say we have a different category of functionality that has historically been in epan, but I would like removed (especially with the addition of Stratoshark).

...and there's "stuff that's used for dissecting arbitrary stuff" (tvbuffs, dissection trees, handoff tables, etc.), "stuff that's used for dissecting protocols"/"stuff that's used for dissecting event logs"/"stuff that's used for dissecting files", and maybe subcategories for them.

However, Wireshark and TShark dissect files that are transported over FTP/HTTP/etc., for example, so maybe that's not as clean a split as some might like.

added 1 commit
  • 66b4f987 - Move AFNUM_ values and value_string to packet-bgp.c
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/22698/diffs?diff_id=1593998107&start_sha=16882eb64758d73ac634f44b1a733971514987ca)
This doesn't look right to me. Stuffing a shared definition into 'just a dissector' and have the others refer to that doesn't make sense to me.

> Just picked a dissector to associate with the data because it's not a public API belonging in \\epan

Why not? It has an official IANA registry, and is not associated with a particular protocol.
I have a better idea on how to justify moving this to the dissector directory, but I want to work through the details more before deciding whether to amend this commit or start a new MR.
Moving discussion to !22729 where the all of the data is dynamically generated, so it can have its own "dissector data file".

commits_data.title: Move AFNUM_ values and value_string to packet-bgp.c
commits_data.message:
Move AFNUM_ values and value_string to packet-bgp.c

Just picked a dissector to associate with the data because it's not a public API belonging in \epan, it's just a shared list of values and value_string between multiple dissectors
